description: A function `(source$) => result$` used inside `pipe()`, such as `map`, `filter` or `debounceTime`.
Emits the latest value only after `ms` milliseconds without new values.
Drops a value when it equals the previous emitted value.
Maps each value to an inner observable and cancels the previous inner subscription.
Flatten inner observables in parallel / in sequence / ignoring new values while busy.
Replaces an error notification with a fallback observable.
